column1: # Your AI subscriptions' own tools: the "who answers" pickers (Terminal, Chat, the Code page's terminal panel) and
# Settings › Claude Code › Your AI subscriptions read this table (portal/portal/answers.py). Each tool is its provider's
# own, unmodified client in the sandbox's image (terminal/Dockerfile's ai-tools stage), signed in there with its own
# flow; the sandbox's terminal/bin/subscriptions has the same ids (tests/test_subscriptions.sh checks both lists).
# id  name  provider  plan  command  signout  chat_model  chat_why  terms
#   plan        whose plan it uses, in a few words
#   command     what to type in the sandbox's terminal
#   signout     cli: it has a sign-out command (Settings' Sign out runs it) | inside: only inside its own screen (said)
#   chat_model  Chat's model list: no (greyed, with chat_why: planned, and under which of the provider's terms) — the tool itself opens in the Chat page either way
#   terms       the provider's page this rests on

column4: your Claude plan (Pro, Max, Team or Enterprise)
column8: Planned as a Chat model on your plan's limits, through the Claude Agent SDK, behind a switch in Settings: Anthropic's support article allows the SDK and claude -p on a plan, while its legal page says other apps may not route requests through a Free, Pro or Max plan on their users' behalf. For now open Claude Code itself here.
